name: context-os
description: Claude Code context optimizer. Builds a local static repo graph, injects ranked file:line candidates through a UserPromptSubmit hook, and adds a SessionStart prewarm brief. No embeddings, no server, no telemetry. Measured live A/B: 40.9% aggregate token reduction across 36 Claude Code calls. v2.9 Receipts: a Stop hook + /savings turn the invisible savings into a live statusLine meter, a day-streak, a dollar figure, and a shareable card.
